newsitem.title: CHINA: AB Capital Markets (HK) places US$30 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: AB Capital Markets (HK) places US$30 mln FRN.

text.p: A US$30 million floating-rate notes issue due July 1999 for a special-purpose vehicle incorporated in the Cayman Islands and wholly-owned by AB Capital Markets (HK) Ltd has been privately placed, bankers said on Monday.
The deal is guaranteed by Asian Banking Corp.
The two-year notes include a put option on the first anniversary, and were issued at par to float at 70 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in returns for participants is 90 basis points.
The other participants are Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce, ING Barings, Peregrine Fixed Income, Chase Manhattan Asia, Societe Generale Asia and Sumitomo Finance Asia.
